notes: Built from the release source with the OpenGL renderer off, packaged as libmelondsds_libretro.so. CMake fetches its dependencies at the commits the release names; melonds_commit pins melonDS itself, which the release tracks by branch. Uses melonDS's built-in BIOS and firmware unless dumps are in the system folder. No BIOS, firmware or ROMs bundled.
